title: Oda za Uber Eats katika McDonald's ya Nagoya zilikuwa za kushangaza
label: Foleni ya Uber Eats

text.🍔 MY McDONALD'S PART-TIME JOB: 🍔 Kazi yangu ya muda katika McDonald's
text.The McDonald's where I worked was near O: McDonald's nilikofanya kazi ilikuwa karibu na Mtaa wa Ununuzi wa Osu mjini Nagoya.
text.Back then, I heard that stores around Sa: Wakati huo nilisikia kuwa migahawa ya eneo la Sakae ilikuwa miongoni mwa mitatu bora nchini kwa mauzo ya Uber Eats.
text.It was surprising that it was Nagoya, no: Ilishangaza kuwa ilikuwa Nagoya, wala si Tokyo au Osaka.
text.Actually, the line of Uber Eats and Dema: Kwa kweli, foleni ya waendesha Uber Eats na Demae-can ilikuwa ndefu kuliko foleni ya wateja dukani.
text.The line went outside the store, and it: Foleni ilifika nje ya duka, na ilionekana kuwa waendesha usafirishaji walikuwa karibu mara mbili ya wateja.
text.McDonald's has company-run stores and fr: McDonald's ina migahawa inayomilikiwa na kampuni na ya franchise, na inahisi tofauti
text.My favorite position at my McDonald's pa: Nafasi niliyoipenda zaidi katika kazi yangu ya muda ya McDonald's ilikuwa runner
